_header: The autopilot lane-queue contract, v1: the ONE place its names and thresholds are defined. Read by tooling/autopilot/issue-queue.mjs (and through it queue-migrate.mjs); docs/autopilot/queue.md describes it and tooling/ci/test/autopilot-queue-doc.test.mjs fails when the doc names a label or threshold this file does not hold. The queue's issues live in the PRIVATE repo; nothing here is lane content.
